focus: Zephyr emerges from his shelter on Sol-3 to witness Nibiru sliding between Sol-3 and its star, casting an engineered perpetual shadow that plunges the planet into grinding cold and disrupts surface populations and refugee survival.
Zephyr felt the change before he saw it—a disturbance in the mathematical harmonics of local space-time that made his consciousness recoil from the quantum calculations he'd been attempting.
A dark world, vast beyond comprehension, sliding between the local star and the planet surface like a predator moving to devour its prey.
Their agricultural systems, barely above subsistence level, started failing as crops froze in fields that had never known winter.
Food production would cease within local cycles.
Energy requirements for basic thermal maintenance would exhaust their consciousness-reserves within a standard year.
